tools.description: Unlock Email Routing DNS records. PATCH /zones/{zone_id}/email/routing/dns. Requires a token with the Zone Settings Write permission.

tools.name: email_routing_dns_delete
tools.title: Disable Email Routing
tools.description: Disable Email Routing. DELETE /zones/{zone_id}/email/routing/dns. What it removes is gone; check the id before calling it. Requires a token with the Zone Settings Write permission. Cloudflare flags this operation as one that asks for confirmation.
